comparison.objective: Seat a loose rack on a pinion so two gripper fingers move evenly; candidate transfers a bearing block onto a jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests gear-phase alignment, rack seating, and coupled mechanism actuation. Candidate tests parallel rail–jig mating and straight supported translation without losing balls.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires both racks seated, symmetric finger travel, minimum opening, stillness, and released hands. Candidate requires complete transfer, continuous support, and intact rolling-element inventory.
comparison.reason: Gear meshing and phase symmetry are not the candidate's rolling-element containment and seam-crossing support ability.
